ask: What was my best LinkedIn post this month?

steps.why: Ranks the whole window, so 10 rows are enough. The order uses each post's total across all its networks: re-rank by the LinkedIn block before naming a winner. Posts with no numbers sort last; leave them out.
A link to the live post from linkedin_metrics.permalink. If it is missing, say there is no link yet; never build one from an id.

say: Acme, Nov 1 to today: your best LinkedIn post was "We cut onboarding to one day..." (Nov 4): 86 likes, 14 comments, 2,310 views (link). 2 posts from this week aren't synced yet, so they're left out. Make 3 more like it?
never: Naming a best LinkedIn post from the all-network total.
Ranking a post whose numbers haven't synced yet.
Building a link from a post id.
Saying "0 views" on a network that doesn't report views.
